title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: withdrawing an application or approved goods
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product only the shipper can withdraw its application or its approved goods, and only before loading. A withdrawal before approval is free. When approved goods are withdrawn, the category's withdrawal fee after approval is charged once; the administration fee already charged at approval stays payable, and no surcharge is charged because nothing was loaded. A withdrawal fee may be booked only on an acceptance whose status is withdrawn. An acceptance carries at most one withdrawal fee. Loaded goods cannot be withdrawn.

## By stage at the time of withdrawal
| Stage | Withdrawal by the shipper | Withdrawal fee | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Application before approval | possible | none — the withdrawal is free | none |
| Approved goods, not yet loaded | possible | the category's fee after approval, once; the administration fee charged at approval stays payable | none, because nothing was loaded |
| Loaded goods | not possible | — | — |

A withdrawal can take an acceptance to withdrawn from submitted, from under review or from approved. The withdrawal fee, where owed, is booked on the acceptance once its status is withdrawn.

## Basis Q&A
- *The shipper withdraws approved goods — is the administration fee reversed?* No; the administration fee charged at approval stays payable.
- *Is any loading surcharge due on withdrawn goods?* No; nothing was loaded.
- *Can a second withdrawal fee be booked on the same acceptance?* No; an acceptance carries at most one withdrawal fee.
- *Can the desk withdraw the application on the shipper's behalf?* The rule reserves withdrawal to the shipper.
